notes: Two crossed roads, a painted plaza, lanterns at the plaza corners and an open shelter on the north approach, on the shared district world world.js already builds from the coast region record.

This is the regional case, not the country case: band_rule is none because makeDistrict paints plaza under its own lanterns, whereas a country venue paints the band last and keeps it clear of solid scenery.
